focused, then disabled: Focused stays true — a disabled element gives the keyboard up to nobody, so a Blur is Done and nothing fires; re-enabled, Blur takes it

the D36 matrix: the 440 segments of the matrix with Value written 50 in the act's frame, or a remount after the slide to 80 — the handle takes the graph's word without Changed, and a remount leaves it where it was (row D36: the runtime fires Changed and takes the author's Value back) — v3 (C74): with Max lowered to 60, the paint draws the handle against it and Value Percent follows
Visible off: a hidden slider is under no pointer and takes no keyboard — every act raises nothing; the Focus action is Done with nothing; shown again, a click is a click
Visible off in the frame of an act: the act's paint hides the slider first — the act raises nothing; one that held the keyboard keeps it (no focus fixup), and a blur takes it off
Visible off after the keyboard is on the slider: it keeps it (no focus fixup), so a slide still lands; blurred, a slide reaches nothing
